query:
SELECT task_id, description, completed_at, terminated_at, time_spent_seconds, deadline 
         FROM user_tasks 
         WHERE user_id = ? 
         ORDER BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN completed_at IS NULL AND terminated_at IS NULL THEN 0 
                WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
                ELSE 2 
            END ASC,
            deadline ASC, 
            task_id DESC 
         LIMIT 25
